description: Thin read-only dashboard rendering the same GetScore payload (score, rung, breakdown, freshness, recommendations) with loading/error/empty states per template standards.

requirements.description: A thin read-only status dashboard UI component must render the GetScore payload returned by ScoreService. The dashboard must display: composite score, maturity rung, per-dimension breakdown, freshness block, and recommendations. The component must implement all required UI states per template standards: loading state (while GetScore is in-flight), error state (when GetScore returns an error or times out), and empty state (when no score data exists for the scenario). The dashboard must not perform any writes or mutations. Selectors must follow the established template selector patterns for testability.
requirements.title: Read-Only Status Dashboard UI Rendering Score Payload with Loading/Error/Empty States
